item.title: 【SD】Linkin Park - Breaking The Habit (custom cg music video) (old fan made?)
item.description:
So, I've had this custom (I guess fan made) music video version of Breaking the Habit by Linkin Park for a long time. Since 1999/real early 2000's or around there era. I actually default to watching it every time I want to watch the music video for this song I enjoy it so much and I just feel like I should maybe try and offer it to any people out there who may feel the same even if just for a collector's item. Just to give a heads up, it's basically an all cg version composed of that gas mask looking guy (Hunk from survivor looking dude) I guess taken from Frgt/10 video. This is my very first thread and possibly my only one so please forgive if I'm not following proper etiquette somehow.

https://www.mediafire.com/file/8opw...-_Breaking_The_Habit_%28CGversion%29.mpg/file
